brief.move_flips: {card_cap} goes to the {cell} and flips {flip_count} opposing card(s) on the spot ({causes}).
Playing {card} on the {cell} takes {flip_count} card(s) back at once, by {causes}.
This move puts {card} on the {cell} and captures {flip_count} card(s): {causes}.
brief.move_quiet: {card_cap} goes to the {cell} and flips nothing now; the point is position and what follows.
Playing {card} on the {cell} captures nothing at once and prepares the next exchanges.
{card_cap} is placed on the {cell} without taking a card; the value lies in the follow-up.
brief.outcome_exact_win: The game is already solved: with {basis}, this move finishes {diff} card(s) ahead and wins.
The whole game has been calculated to the end: with {basis}, this move wins by {diff} card(s).
brief.outcome_exact_draw: The game is already solved: with {basis}, both sides end with the same number of cards, a draw.
The whole game has been calculated to the end: with {basis}, this move leads to a draw.
brief.outcome_exact_loss: The game is already solved: with {basis}, even the best play ends {diff} card(s) short, so the position is unfavourable.
The whole game has been calculated to the end: with {basis}, the best result of this move is {diff} card(s) down.
brief.outcome_heuristic_ahead: Searched to depth {depth}, position score {score}: slightly ahead for now.
Looking {depth} plies ahead the score is {score}, which favours our side.
brief.outcome_heuristic_level: Searched to depth {depth}, position score {score}: roughly level.
Looking {depth} plies ahead the score is {score}, close to balance.
brief.outcome_heuristic_behind: Searched to depth {depth}, position score {score}: slightly behind for now.
Looking {depth} plies ahead the score is {score}, which is not quite in our favour.
full.immediate_flips: Move: {card} on the {cell}. Flips: {flip_list}. Card count: ours {before_mine} becomes {after_mine}, the opponent's {before_theirs} becomes {after_theirs}.
This move puts {card} on the {cell}. It flips: {flip_list}. The count goes from {before_mine} against {before_theirs} to {after_mine} against {after_theirs}.
full.immediate_quiet: Move: {card} on the {cell}. It flips nothing; the count stays at {after_mine} for us and {after_theirs} for the opponent.
This move puts {card} on the {cell} without a flip, so the count is still {after_mine} against {after_theirs}.
full.flip.basic: the card #{their_id} on the {cell} ({my_side} side {my_value} against {their_value}, the higher value wins)
full.flip.reverse: the card #{their_id} on the {cell} ({my_side} side {my_value} against {their_value}, under Reverse the lower value wins)
full.flip.fallen_ace: the card #{their_id} on the {cell} ({my_side} side {my_value} against {their_value}, Fallen Ace applies)
full.flip.same: the card #{their_id} on the {cell} (Same: our {my_side} side {my_value} equals it)
full.flip.plus: the card #{their_id} on the {cell} (Plus: {my_side} side {my_value} plus {their_value} makes {sum}, equal to the sum on another side)
full.flip.combo: the card #{their_id} on the {cell} (Combo: flipped on from the card taken on the {via}, {my_side} side {my_value} against {their_value})
full.modifier: The {type} rule changed the bonus of that card type from {from} to {to} ({board} card(s) on the board and {hand} in hand are affected).
full.exposure_position: The card lands on {position} of the board.
This puts the card on {position} of the board.
full.exposure_sides_open: The sides still facing an empty cell are: {sides}; the opponent can attack from those directions next turn.
After the move these sides still face an empty cell: {sides}. They can be attacked on the next turn.
full.exposure_sides_closed: No side faces an empty cell afterwards, so the opponent cannot attack this card directly from a neighbouring cell.
full.exposure_safe: None of the opponent's cards can take this card back on the next turn.
According to the current assumptions, no opposing card can flip this card back next turn.
full.exposure_threat: The opponent's card #{threat_id}{assumed} on the {threat_cell} can retake this card by {threat_cause} (that move flips {captured} card(s) in all).
Card #{threat_id}{assumed} played on the {threat_cell} takes this card back by {threat_cause} and flips {captured} card(s) in total.
full.exposure_unknown: Of the {candidates} legal possibilities for the opponent's unknown card, about {percent}% could retake this card next turn.
Among {candidates} candidate cards, roughly {percent}% would let the opponent take this card back next turn.
full.reply: Expected strongest reply: card #{reply_id}{assumed} on the {reply_cell}, {reply_effect}.
The search considers the opponent's best answer to be card #{reply_id}{assumed} on the {reply_cell}, {reply_effect}.
full.pv: Principal variation (the search expects both sides to play this): {line}.
full.outcome_note_heuristic: This is a heuristic score, not a final result: search depth {depth}, score {score} ({empty} empty cell(s) remain).
full.alt_intro: Other moves (all scored at depth {eval_depth}; the chosen move scores {chosen_score}):
Compared with the alternatives (searched to the same depth {eval_depth}; the chosen move scores {chosen_score}):
full.delta_equal: the same score as the chosen move
full.why.tied: the scores are tied, the two moves are equivalent for the search
full.why.heuristic_better: its heuristic score is higher, but the safety analysis did not pick it
full.why.exposed_to_reply: the opponent's card #{reply_id}{assumed} on the {reply_cell} can retake this card by {cause} ({their_side} side {their_value} against {my_value})
full.why.fewer_captures: it flips only {alt_flips} card(s) now, the chosen move flips {chosen_flips}
full.why.bigger_counter: the opponent's best reply would flip {alt_reply_flips} card(s), against {chosen_reply_flips} after the chosen move
full.robust: Endgame over the possible hidden cards: {scenarios} possible opposing hands were considered. In {safety_percent}% of them this move does not fall behind; the average card difference is {average} and the worst case is {worst}.
The endgame was worked out for each of {scenarios} possible opposing hands: this move holds up in {safety_percent}% of them, with an average card difference of {average} and a worst case of {worst}.
full.robust_single: The endgame is completely worked out (no opposing card has to be guessed): the final card difference of this move is {average}.
full.robust_override: This move differs from the first choice of the ordinary search: the endgame layer picked it instead, {rule}.
The ordinary search preferred another move; the endgame analysis changed it to this one, {rule}.
full.robust_keep: The first choice of the ordinary search agrees with the endgame analysis.
full.override_rule.safety_floor: because the earlier move held in under half of the cases while this one holds in half or more
full.override_rule.safer_and_close: because this move is safer and its overall score is very close to the earlier one
full.override_rule.clearly_better: because the overall score of this move is clearly higher
full.override_rule.aggressive_margin: because in aggressive mode its overall score is clearly higher and its safety share is high enough
full.unknown_none: There are no unknown opposing cards to assume.
full.unknown_assumed: The opponent has {count} unknown card(s); they were assumed using {strategy}. The assumption for this decision: {cards}.
{count} opposing card(s) are unknown. The method used was {strategy}, and this time the cards taken were: {cards}.
full.strategy.rule_model: a rule-driven model of the opponent (main rule: {rule})
full.strategy.random_sample: a random sample of the whole card database
full.strategy.threat_ranking: a pick by how much the cards threaten the current board
full.confidence_solved: Confidence: the search covered the whole game (depth {depth}, {empty} empty cell(s)), {nodes} nodes in all.
Confidence: the game was searched to the end, depth {depth}, {nodes} nodes.
full.confidence_partial: Confidence: search depth {depth} (limit requested {requested}, {empty} empty cell(s) left), {nodes} nodes; the conclusion is heuristic.
Confidence: searched to depth {depth} (limit {requested}), {nodes} nodes; {empty} cell(s) are still empty, so the judgement is heuristic.
full.confidence_stopped: The search stopped early because of the time or node limit.
